name: gg-secondary-pensions
description: Prepare 2026 Guernsey secondary-pension enrolment and contribution working papers for employers. Covers designated and voluntary employees, phased employer start dates, minimum contributions, the earnings base, enrolment deferral, opt-outs, refunds, re-enrolment and quarterly reporting. Distinguishes payments to the pension provider from Revenue Service returns and social-insurance contributions. Use for workplace pension setup, payroll contribution calculations and compliance reviews. Based on official employer guidance checked in October 2026. Direct statutory reconciliation, detailed enforcement, scheme-specific conditions and independent review remain outstanding; this source-cited draft does not establish comprehensive payroll coverage or professional attestation.
